profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Professional software developer with over 10 years experience. Strengths include teamwork, resourcefulness and problem-solving skills. Experience in B2C and B2B web applications. Seeking professional growth in the field of Artificial Intelligence - Machine Learning - and Data Science. Hands on experience with Python, PHP, Javascript, Typescript, MySql, MS SQL, Node.js, Angular, Magento, Azure DevOps

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Ensure stability and growth of company’s e-commerce website based on Magento 1.
- Plan and execute migration from Magento 1 to Magento 2.  
- Developed Angular application/ERP for pest control service industry.
- Access and manipulate different data sources for reporting and integration with multiple business components.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Participated in the migration project from Yahoo Store to Magento Enterprise.
- Mined and analyzed data from legacy Yahoo Store site to be migrated to Magento Store.
- Integrated in-house systems with new Magento Store through SOAP v1 API.
- Supported graphic design team with front end development to implement new theming for Magento Store.
- Created system configurator with built-in compatibility that allows users picking up computer parts and assemble customized systems.
- Wrote Magento customized Modules.
- Implemented a Magento Punchout catalog for one of the biggest Independent School Districts in the Houston Area.

positions.title: Systems Specialist
positions.description:
Software development and external supplier coordinator.
- Managed integration project which links Financial, Academic and Administrative Systems on a single platform reducing administrative processes time of more than 300 people by 50%.

positions.title: Systems Analyst
positions.description:
Software designer and developer.
- Automated Parking System with custom program allocating parking for 4,000 cars and eliminating outdated spreadsheet use.
- Designed application that handles over 200 parameters used in government evaluation models applied in over 50 careers, reducing dramatically time to get reports and up to date information by 60%.
- Managed and maintained legacy software for computer center with over 250 computers.

positions.title: Telematics Manager
positions.description:
GIS Software administration, software development.
- Developed official web site for SIGTIERRAS with GIS information on 221 cities in Ecuador.
- Customized and implemented Support Ticket System to serve over 40 requests daily for technical assistance of rural areas of Ecuador.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Developed customized and interactive web sites for companies in market sectors such as education, retailers, tourism, NGO’s.
- Created administration system for training company with over 100 corporative clients nationwide and 15 weekly seminars.
- Managed over 200 hosting accounts providing technical support on issues related to web programming, databases and server configurations.

positions.title: IT Support Technician
positions.description:
Support and administration of airport systems.
- Managed Flight Information System for Mariscal Sucre International Airport with over 150 daily flights.
- Gave technical support for over 15 national and international airlines.

positions.title: IT Support Technician
positions.description:
Support of Banking Software, maintenance of legacy software, helpdesk.
- Installed and maintained banking software used by 200 locations nationwide in Ecuador.
- Provided technical support for over 25 bank agencies of Pacific National Bank in 3 cities in Ecuador.
